An input marked with "extension" is NOT passed to the hydra function -- its
body stays verbatim. The emitter applies it at the call site instead.
blend_amount: hydra gives add/sub/mult/blend an `amount` that fades the result
back toward the source -- (result)*amount + _c0*(1-amount). layer, diff and
mask were left without one. This adds it, defaulting to 1, which is exactly
hydra's behaviour; only a value below 1 diverges.
